**Question**

Work out $\dfrac{2}{5} + \dfrac{3}{8}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $\dfrac{2}{5} + \dfrac{3}{8}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2} {5} + \dfrac {3} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 8} {5 \times 8} + \dfrac {3 \times 5} {8 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{ 16} {40} + \dfrac {15} {40} \\\\
&= \dfrac {16 + 15} {40} \\\\
&= \dfrac {31} {40}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

Work out $\dfrac{4}{5} + \dfrac{7}{10}$ then write your answer as a mixed number.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What fraction is $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of $\dfrac{3}{4}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What fraction is $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of $\dfrac{3}{4}$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2} {3} \ \text {of} \ \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\

&= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {3 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {3 \times 2 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3} \times \cancel {2} \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many sixths are there in $3 \dfrac{1}{3}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many sixths are there in $3 \dfrac{1}{3}$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \dfrac{1}{3} \div \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10} {3} \div \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10} {3} \times 6 \\\\
&= \dfrac {10 \times 6} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10 \times 2 \times 3} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10 \times 2 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 10 \times 2 \\\\
&= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20$

</div>
</div>

&= \dfrac {10} {3} \div \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10} {3} \times 6 \\\\
&= \dfrac {10 \times 6} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10 \times 2 \times 3} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10 \times 2 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 10 \times 2 \\\\
&= 20
\end{aligned}
$

Chan now empties the jug of water by pouring equal amounts into six identical empty beakers. 
One of the beakers is shown in the diagram.

Draw a line on the beaker to indicate the level of water in it.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Water in each beaker}                      &= \dfrac {\text{total water}} {\text{total beakers}} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {1800} {6} \\\\
                                                  &= 300 \text {ml} \\\\
\text {Water in one division of beaker}           &= \dfrac {\text{total capacity}} {\text{number of divisions}} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {400} {8} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {8 \times 50} {8} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel{8} \times 50} {\cancel{8}} \\\\
                                                  &= 50 \\\\
\text{Number of divisions containing 300ml water} &= \dfrac {300} {50} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {50 \times 6} {50} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel{50} \times 6} {50} \\\\
                                                  &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

6th division is to be marked.

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's make the denominator the same for all the fractions.

LCM of $4, 3$ and $10 = 60$

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{3}{4} , \quad \dfrac{2}{3} , \quad \dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 15}{4 \times 15} , \quad \dfrac{2 \times 20}{3 \times 20} , \quad \dfrac{7 \times 6}{10 \times 6} \\\\
&= \dfrac{45}{60}, \quad \dfrac{40}{60}, \quad \dfrac{42}{60}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Largest fraction} &= \dfrac{45}{60} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{3}{4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write (as a **decimal**) the difference between $\dfrac{3}{4}$ and $\dfrac{7}{10}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write (as a **decimal**) the difference between $\dfrac{3}{4}$ and $\dfrac{7}{10}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{3}{4} - \dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 5}{4 \times 5} - \dfrac{7 \times 2}{10 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac{15}{20} - \dfrac{14}{20} \\\\
&= \dfrac{15-14}{20} \\\\
&= \dfrac{1}{20} \\\\
&= \dfrac{5}{5 \times 20} \\\\
&= \dfrac{5}{100} \\\\
&= 0.05
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$0.05$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On consecutive days you eat $\dfrac{1}{3}$ and $\dfrac{1}{6}$ of a lasagne. 

What fraction of lasagne have you eaten?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On consecutive days you eat $\dfrac{1}{3}$ and $\dfrac{1}{6}$ of a lasagne. 
<emptyline>
What fraction of lasagne have you eaten?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of lasagne eaten} &= \dfrac {1} {3} + \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {1 \times 2} {3 \times 2} + \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {2} {6} + \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {2 + 1} {6} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3} {6} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3} {3 \times 2} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel {3}} {\cancel {3} \times 2} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {2}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out the following subtraction, giving your final answer as a mixed number in its lowest terms:

$3 \dfrac{2}{7} - 1 \dfrac{1}{3}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the following subtraction, giving your final answer as a mixed number in its lowest terms:
<emptyline>
$3 \dfrac{2}{7} - 1 \dfrac{1}{3}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \dfrac {2} {7} - 1 \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {23} {7} - \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {23 \times 3} {7 \times 3} - \dfrac {4 \times 7} {3 \times 7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {69} {21} - \dfrac {28} {21} \\\\
&= \dfrac {69 - 28} {21} \\\\
&= \dfrac {41} {21} \\\\
&= 1 \dfrac {20} {21}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

- $4 \dfrac{47}{60}$

</div>

<emptyline>

<emptyline>

&= \dfrac {10} {3} + \dfrac {29} {20} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10 \times 20} {3 \times 20}  + \dfrac {29 \times 3} {20 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {200} {60} + \dfrac {87} {60} \\\\
&= \dfrac {200 + 87} {60} \\\\
&= \dfrac {287} {60} \\\\
&= 4 \dfrac {47} {60}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$3\dfrac{1}{3} + 1 \dfrac{9}{20} =$

- $4 \dfrac{9}{60}$ 

- $4 \dfrac{49}{60}$ 

- $4 \dfrac{10}{23}$ 

- $4 \dfrac{47}{60}$ 


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$3\dfrac{1}{3} + 1 \dfrac{9}{20} =$
<emptyline>
- $4 \dfrac{9}{60}$ 
<emptyline>
- $4 \dfrac{49}{60}$ 
<emptyline>
- $4 \dfrac{10}{23}$ 
<emptyline>
- $4 \dfrac{47}{60}$ 
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \dfrac{1}{3} + 1 \dfrac{9}{20} \\\\
&= \dfrac{10}{3} + \dfrac{29}{20} \\\\
&= \dfrac{10 \times 20}{3 \times 20}  + \dfrac{29 \times 3}{20 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{200}{60} + \dfrac{87}{60} \\\\
&= \dfrac{200 + 87}{60} \\\\
&= \dfrac{287}{60} \\\\
&= 4 \dfrac{47}{60}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= 3 + 1 + \dfrac {1}{3} + \dfrac {9}{20} \\\\
&= 4 + \dfrac {1 \times 20} {3 \times 20} + \dfrac {9 \times 3} {20 \times 3} \\\\
&= 4 + \dfrac {20} {60} + \dfrac {27} {60} \\\\
&= 4 + \dfrac {20 + 27} {60} \\\\
&= 4 + \dfrac {47} {60} \\\\
&= 4\dfrac {47}{60}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Even though the method of cancelling shown below is incorrect, the student has got the correct answer by chance. Can you find a similar fraction which will cancel down to give $\dfrac{2}{5}?$

![papers/city-of-london-school/2008/sample-paper-group-2/s01-q20-i00.png](/assets/papers/city-of-london-school/2008/sample-paper-group-2/s01-q20-i00.png "papers/city-of-london-school/2008/sample-paper-group-2/s01-q20-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Even though the method of cancelling shown below is incorrect, the student has got the correct answer by chance. Can you find a similar fraction which will cancel down to give $\dfrac{2}{5}?$
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

We can easily infer the value by using trial and error.

We need a fraction that simplifies to $\dfrac{2}{5}$.

|    Fraction     |     Simplification        | Equals $\dfrac{2}{5}$? |
|:---------------:|:-------------------------------------------------:|:-----------------------:|
| $\dfrac{21}{15}$ | $\dfrac{21 \div 3}{15 \div 3} = \dfrac{7}{5}$     | No                      |
| $\dfrac{22}{25}$ | $\dfrac{22}{25}$ (no common factor)              | No                      |
| $\dfrac{23}{35}$ | $\dfrac{23}{35}$ (no common factor)              | No                      |
| $\dfrac{24}{45}$ | $\dfrac{24 \div 3}{45 \div 3} = \dfrac{8}{15}$    | No                      |
| $\dfrac{25}{55}$ | $\dfrac{25 \div 5}{55 \div 5} = \dfrac{5}{11}$    | No                      |
| $\dfrac{26}{65}$ | $\dfrac{26 \div 13}{65 \div 13} = \dfrac{2}{5}$   | Yes                  |
| $\dfrac{27}{75}$ | $\dfrac{27 \div 3}{75 \div 3} = \dfrac{9}{25}$    | No                      |
| $\dfrac{28}{85}$ | $\dfrac{28}{85}$ (no common factor)              | No                      |
| $\dfrac{29}{95}$ | $\dfrac{29}{95}$ (no common factor)              | No                      |

Answer $= \dfrac{26}{65}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{26}{65}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

![papers/city-of-london-school/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q08-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/city-of-london-school/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q08-s01-i00.png "papers/city-of-london-school/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q08-s01-i00.png")

What fraction of the above design is shaded? Give your fraction in its simplest form.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

What fraction of the above design is shaded? Give your fraction in its simplest form.

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction shaded}  &= \dfrac {4} {12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {4} {4 \times 3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{4}} {\cancel{4} \times 3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many more of the hexagons need to be shaded so that $\dfrac{3} {4}$ of the design is shaded? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many more of the hexagons need to be shaded so that $\dfrac{3} {4}$ of the design is shaded? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction shaded}  &= \dfrac {3} {4} \times 12  - 4 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 12} {4} - 4 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 3 \times 4} {4} - 4 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 3 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} - 4 \\\\
                        &= 3 \times 3- 4 \\\\
                        &= 9 - 4 \\\\
                        &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $\dfrac{1}{2}$ of $\dfrac{4}{5}$ of $35?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $\dfrac{1}{2}$ of $\dfrac{4}{5}$ of $35?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{of} \ \dfrac {4} {5} \ \text {of} \ 35 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {4} {5} \times 35 \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 35} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 7 \times 5} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel {2} \times 7 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {2} \times \cancel {5}} \\\\
&= 2 \times 7 \\\\
&= 14
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$14$

</div>

\end{aligned}

<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

&= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times 2}{2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
&= 7 \times 2 \\\\
&= 14
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What fraction of an hour is $12 \ \text{minutes}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What fraction of an hour is $12 \ \text{minutes}$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

                    &= \dfrac {12} {12 \times 5} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {12}} {\cancel {12} \times 5} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {5}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which fraction is $\dfrac {42} {63}$ equivalent to?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which fraction is $\dfrac {42} {63}$ equivalent to?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {42} {63} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 3 \times 2} {7 \times 3 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {7} \times \cancel {3} \times 2} {\cancel {7} \times \cancel {3} \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2}{3} 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A prime number has exactly $2$ factors: itself and $1$.

The numbers from $1$ to $20$ inclusive are written on $20$ cards. Write down the **proportion** of all the cards that have a 
prime number written on them, giving your answer as a decimal.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A prime number has exactly $2$ factors: itself and $1$.
<emptyline>
The numbers from $1$ to $20$ inclusive are written on $20$ cards. Write down the **proportion** of all the cards that have a 
prime number written on them, giving your answer as a decimal.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Prime numbers up to 20} &= 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 \\\\
\text{Count}                  &= 8 \\\\
\text {Proportion}            &= \dfrac {8} {20} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {8 \times 5} {20 \times 5} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {40} {100} \\\\
                              &= 0.4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

By how much is four and a half greater than three and seven eights? Write your answer as a fraction. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">By how much is four and a half greater than three and seven eights? Write your answer as a fraction. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 4 \dfrac {1} {2} - 3 \dfrac {7} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {2} - \dfrac {31} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 \times 4} {2 \times 4} - \dfrac {31} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {36} {8} - \dfrac {31} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {36 - 31} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5} {8}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The diagram shows a design formed by drawing six lines in a regular hexagon. The lines divide each edge of the hexagon into three equal parts. What fraction of the hexagon is shaded?

![papers/dulwich-college/sample/specimen-paper-g/s01-q18-i00.png](/assets/papers/dulwich-college/sample/specimen-paper-g/s01-q18-i00.png "papers/dulwich-college/sample/specimen-paper-g/s01-q18-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The diagram shows a design formed by drawing six lines in a regular hexagon. The lines divide each edge of the hexagon into three equal parts. What fraction of the hexagon is shaded?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {number of triangles in one hexagon} &= 6 \\\\
\text {total triangles}                    &= 6 \times 7 + 12 \\\\
                                           &= 42 + 12 \\\\
                                           &= 54 \\\\
\text {fraction of hexagon shaded}         &= \dfrac {12} {54} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {2 \times 6} {6 \times 9} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel{6}} {\cancel{6} \times 9} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {2} {9}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\dfrac {2} {9}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What fraction is half-way between $2$ and $2.5?$

-  $\dfrac{7}{2}$

-  $\dfrac{7}{4}$

-  $\dfrac{9}{4}$

-  $\dfrac{11}{4}$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What fraction is half-way between $2$ and $2.5?$
<emptyline>
-  $\dfrac{7}{2}$
<emptyline>
-  $\dfrac{7}{4}$
<emptyline>
-  $\dfrac{9}{4}$
<emptyline>
-  $\dfrac{11}{4}$ 
</code></pre>
</div>

&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times (2 + 2.5) \\\\
&= \dfrac {4.5} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {45} {2 \times 10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 \times 5} {2 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel{5} } {2 \times 2 \times \cancel{5} } \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {4}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $30$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $30$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

&= \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text {of} \ 30 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {4} \times 30 \\\\

&= \dfrac {45} {2} \\\\
&= 22 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What number is exactly halfway between $1\dfrac{1}{2}$ and $3?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What number is exactly halfway between $1\dfrac{1}{2}$ and $3?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( 1\dfrac {1} {2} + 3 \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {3} {1} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {3 \times 2} {1 \times 2} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {6} {2} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3 + 6} {2} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {9} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {4} \\\\
&= 2\dfrac {1} {4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2\dfrac {1}{4}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( 1\dfrac {1} {2} + 3 \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {3} {1} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {3 \times 2} {1 \times 2} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {6} {2} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3 + 6} {2} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {9} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {4} \\\\
&= 2\dfrac {1} {4}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$2\dfrac {1}{4}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many thirds are there in $2\dfrac{2}{3}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many thirds are there in $2\dfrac{2}{3}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 2 \dfrac{2}{3} \div \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8} {3} \div \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8} {3} \times 3 \\\\
&= \dfrac {8 \times 3} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is a quarter of $398?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is a quarter of $398?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \text {quarter of } 398 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times 398 \\\\
&= \dfrac {398} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {199 \times 2} {2 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {199 \times \cancel{2}} {2 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {199} {2} \\\\
&= 99.5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$99.5$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $5\%$ of $5\ \text{kg}$? Give your answer in grams.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $5\%$ of $5\ \text{kg}$? Give your answer in grams.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 5 \% \ \text {of} \ 5 \ \text {kg} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5} {100} \times 5 \times 1000 \ \text {grams} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 5 \times 1000} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 5 \times 10 \cancel {00}} {1 \cancel {00}} \\\\
&= 5 \times 5 \times 10 \\\\
&= 250 \ \text {grams}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $3 \dfrac{1}{2} \div \dfrac{1}{4}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $3 \dfrac{1}{2} \div \dfrac{1}{4}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \dfrac {1}{2} \div \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7}{2} \times 4 \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 4}{2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times 2}{2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
&= 7 \times 2 \\\\
&= 14
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$14$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What fraction is bigger: 

two thirds or three quarters?
You must justify your answer clearly. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}

&= \dfrac {2 \times 4} {3 \times 4} \quad \boxed {\phantom{15}} \quad \dfrac {3 \times 3} {4 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8} {12} \quad \boxed {\phantom{15}} \quad \dfrac {9} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8} {12} \quad < \quad \dfrac {9} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {3} \quad < \quad \dfrac {3} {4}
\end{aligned}
$

As per the calculation above, three quarters is greater than two thirds.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $4 \dfrac{1}{2} - 1 \dfrac{3}{4}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $4 \dfrac{1}{2} - 1 \dfrac{3}{4}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 4 \dfrac {1} {2} - 1 \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {2} - \dfrac {7} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 \times 2} {2 \times 2} - \dfrac {7} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {18} {4} - \dfrac {7} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {18 - 7} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {11} {4} \\\\
&= 2 \dfrac {3} {4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of $0.02?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of $0.02?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text {of} \ 0.02 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times 0.02 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times \dfrac {20} {1000} \\\\
&= \dfrac {20} {4 \times 1000} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 4} {1000 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel {4}} {1000 \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5} {1000} \\\\
&= 0.005
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Multiply $21$ by $\dfrac{2}{7}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Multiply $21$ by $\dfrac{2}{7}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2} {7} \times 21 \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 21} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 7} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
&= 2 \times 3 \\\\
&= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\dfrac{2}{5} \div \dfrac{4}{10}$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2} {5} \div  \dfrac {4} {10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {5} \times \dfrac {10} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 10} {5 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {20} {20} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {20}} {\cancel {20}} \\\\
&=1
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

Write down two fractions which are equivalent to $\dfrac{4}{5}$ where one of the numbers is twenty.

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {4} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 5} {5 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {20} {25}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {4} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 4} {5 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {16} {20}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of $30$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of $30$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2} {5} \ \text{of} \ 30 \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {5} \times 30 \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 30} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 6} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel {5} \times 6} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
&= 2 \times 6 \\\\
&= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 72 \\\\

&= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 36} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
&= 36
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The figure shows two identical overlapping triangles. Four-ninths of each triangle is shaded.
What fraction of the whole figure is shaded?

![papers/king-edwards-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s03-q01-i00.png](/assets/papers/king-edwards-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s03-q01-i00.png "papers/king-edwards-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s03-q01-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The figure shows two identical overlapping triangles. Four-ninths of each triangle is shaded.
What fraction of the whole figure is shaded?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the area of one traingle $= a$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Area of the figure}      &= a + a - \dfrac {4} {9} \times a \\\\
                                &= 2a - \dfrac {4a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2a \times 9} {9} - \dfrac {4a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {18a} {9} - \dfrac {4a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {18a - 4a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {14a} {9} \\\\
\text {Fraction shaded}         &= \dfrac {4a} {9} \div \dfrac {14a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {4a} {9} \times \dfrac {9} {14a} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {4 \times a \times 9} {9 \times 14 \times a} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 2  \times a \times 9} {9 \times 2 \times 7 \times a } \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 2 \times \cancel{a} \times \cancel{9}} {\cancel{9} \times \cancel{2} \times 7 \times \cancel{a} } \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2} {7}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {2} {7}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

$

                                &= 2a - \dfrac {4a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2a \times 9} {9} - \dfrac {4a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {18a} {9} - \dfrac {4a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {18a - 4a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {14a} {9} \\\\
\text {Fraction shaded}         &= \dfrac {4a} {9} \div \dfrac {14a} {9} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {4a} {9} \times \dfrac {9} {14a} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {4 \times a \times 9} {9 \times 14 \times a} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 2  \times a \times 9} {9 \times 2 \times 7 \times a } \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 2 \times \cancel{a} \times \cancel{9}} {\cancel{9} \times \cancel{2} \times 7 \times \cancel{a} } \\\\

\end{aligned}

**Question**

How much is three-sevenths of $196?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much is three-sevenths of $196?$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {3} {7} \ \text {of} \ 196 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {7} \times {196} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 196} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 28 \times 7} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 28 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 28 \\\\
&= 84
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out three-sevenths of $91$.

- $42$
- $39$
- $36$
- $26$
- $13$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {3} {7} \text{ of } 91 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {7} \times 91 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 91} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 13 \times 7} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 13 \times \cancel{7}} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 13 \\\\
&= 39
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What number is halfway between $4\dfrac{1}{2}$ and $7\dfrac{1}{2}$ ?

- $5\dfrac{1}{4}$

- $5\dfrac{1}{2}$

- $5\dfrac{3}{4}$

-  $6$

- $6\dfrac{1}{4}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What number is halfway between $4\dfrac{1}{2}$ and $7\dfrac{1}{2}$ ?
<emptyline>
- $5\dfrac{1}{4}$
<emptyline>
- $5\dfrac{1}{2}$
<emptyline>
- $5\dfrac{3}{4}$
<emptyline>
-  $6$
<emptyline>
- $6\dfrac{1}{4}$
</code></pre>
</div>

\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg(4 \dfrac {1} {2} + 7 \dfrac {1} {2} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg(\dfrac {9} {2} + \dfrac {15} {2}\bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg(\dfrac {9 + 15} {2}\bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {24} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {24} {2 \times 2} \\\\

&= 6
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Work out three eighths of $264$. 

- $61$ 

- $88$ 

- $96$ 

- $99$ 

- $108$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In an orchestra of $24$ children, $\dfrac{3} {4}$ of them are girls. How many are boys?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In an orchestra of $24$ children, $\dfrac{3} {4}$ of them are girls. How many are boys?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$

\text {Fraction of boys} &= 1 - \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
\text {Number of boys}   &= \dfrac {1} {4} \times 24 \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {24} {4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {6 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} \\\\
                         &= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$\dfrac{3} {5}$ of the pupils at a school stay for lunch.

If there are $750$ pupils at the school, how many stay for lunch?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac{3} {5}$ of the pupils at a school stay for lunch.
<emptyline>
If there are $750$ pupils at the school, how many stay for lunch?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Pupils who stay for lunch}  &= \dfrac {3} {5} \times 750 \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3 \times 750} {5} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3 \times 150 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3 \times 150 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                                   &= 3 \times 150 \\\\
                                   &= 450
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$450$

</div>

Let's convert all the fractions into decimals for comparison.

| Fraction          | Decimal          |  $< 0.\overline{1}$  |
|:-----------------:|:----------------:|:--------------------:|

| $\dfrac{1}{100}$  | $0.01$           | Yes                 |
| $\dfrac{1}{8}$    | $0.125$          | No                  |

Fractions smaller than $\dfrac{1}{9}$  $= \dfrac{1}{10}, \dfrac{1}{100}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a magazine there are three adverts on the same page.

Advert $1$ uses $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the page

Advert $2$ uses $\dfrac{1}{8}$ of the page

Advert $3$ uses $\dfrac{1}{16}$ of the page

In total, what fraction of the page do three adverts use?

Show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a magazine there are three adverts on the same page.
<emptyline>
Advert $1$ uses $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the page
<emptyline>
Advert $2$ uses $\dfrac{1}{8}$ of the page
<emptyline>
Advert $3$ uses $\dfrac{1}{16}$ of the page
<emptyline>
In total, what fraction of the page do three adverts use?
<emptyline>
Show your working.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total fraction of the page used} &= \dfrac {1} {4} + \dfrac {1} {8} + \dfrac {1} {16} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {1 \times 4} {4 \times 4} + \dfrac {1 \times 2} {8 \times 2} + \dfrac {1 \times 1} {16 \times 1} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {4} {16} + \dfrac {2} {16} + \dfrac {1} {16} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {4 + 2 + 1} {16} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {7} {16}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {7} {16}$

</div>
</div>

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total fraction of the page used} &= \dfrac {1} {4} + \dfrac {1} {8} + \dfrac {1} {16} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {1 \times 4} {4 \times 4} + \dfrac {1 \times 2} {8 \times 2} + \dfrac {1 \times 1} {16 \times 1} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {4} {16} + \dfrac {2} {16} + \dfrac {1} {16} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {4 + 2 + 1} {16} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {7} {16}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Complete the table below, giving fractions in their lowest terms.

| Fraction        | Decimal | Percentage |
|:---------------:|:-------:|:----------:|
|                 |         | $50\%$     |
|                 | $0.75$  |            |
| $\dfrac{3}{5}$  |         |            |
| $\dfrac{17}{20}$|         |            |

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Complete the table below, giving fractions in their lowest terms.
<emptyline>
| Fraction        | Decimal | Percentage |
|:---------------:|:-------:|:----------:|
|                 |         | $50\%$     |
|                 | $0.75$  |            |
| $\dfrac{3}{5}$  |         |            |
| $\dfrac{17}{20}$|         |            |
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's work row by row.

Row 1:

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction}         &= 50\%  \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{50}{100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{50 \times 1}{50 \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{\cancel{50} \times 1}{\cancel{50} \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
\text{Decimal}          &= 50\%  \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{50}{100} \\\\
                        &= 0.5
\end{aligned}
$

---

Row 2:

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction}         &= 0.75 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{75}{100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{25 \times 3}{25 \times 4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{\cancel{25} \times 3}{\cancel{25} \times 4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{3}{4} \\\\
\text{Percentage}       &= 0.75 \\\\
                        &= 0.75 \times 100 \\\\
                        &= 75\%
\end{aligned}
$

---

Row 3:

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Decimal}          &= \dfrac{3}{5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{3 \times 20}{5 \times 20} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{60}{100} \\\\
                        &= 0.6 \\\\
\text{Percentage}       &= 0.6 \\\\
                        &= 0.6 \times 100 \\\\
                        &= 60\%
\end{aligned}
$

---

Row 4:

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Decimal}          &= \dfrac{17}{20} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{17 \times 5}{20 \times 5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{85}{100} \\\\
                        &= 0.85 \\\\
\text{Percentage}       &= 0.85 \\\\
                        &= 0.85 \times 100 \\\\
                        &= 85\%
\end{aligned}
$

| Fraction        | Decimal | Percentage |
|:---------------:|:-------:|:----------:|
| $\dfrac{1}{2}$  | $0.5$   | $50\%$     |
| $\dfrac{3}{4}$  | $0.75$  | $75\%$     |
| $\dfrac{3}{5}$  | $0.6$   | $60\%$     |
| $\dfrac{17}{20}$| $0.85$  | $85\%$     |
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of $2 \dfrac{1}{4}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of $2 \dfrac{1}{4}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{1}{3} \ \text{of} \ 2 \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {3} \times 2 \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {9} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {3 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 3} {3 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 3} {\cancel 3 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which fraction is half way between $\dfrac{3}{7}$ and $\dfrac{4}{7}?$

Give your answer in its simplest form.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which fraction is half way between $\dfrac{3}{7}$ and $\dfrac{4}{7}?$
<emptyline>
Give your answer in its simplest form.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3} {7} + \dfrac {4} {7} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {3 + 4} {7} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {7} {7} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 1 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which fraction is bigger, four fifths or eight ninths?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which fraction is bigger, four fifths or eight ninths?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {4} {5}  \quad \boxed {\phantom{15}} \quad \dfrac {8} {9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 9} {5 \times 9} \quad \boxed {\phantom{15}} \quad \dfrac {8 \times 5} {9 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {36} {45} \quad \boxed {\phantom{15}} \quad \dfrac {40} {45} \\\\
&= \dfrac {36} {45} \quad < \quad \dfrac {40} {45} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4} {5} \quad < \quad \dfrac {8} {9}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\dfrac {8} {9}$

**Question**

Calculate two thirds of five and a quarter.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate two thirds of five and a quarter.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2} {3} \text{ of } 5 \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {3} \times 5 \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {21} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 21} {3 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 7 \times 3} {3 \times 2 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 7 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3} \times \cancel{2} \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac{7} {2} \\\\
&= 3 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Four cakes are divided equally amongst seven people. One fifth of a cake is left over. What fraction of a cake does each person get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Four cakes are divided equally amongst seven people. One fifth of a cake is left over. What fraction of a cake does each person get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Each persons share}    &= \dfrac{1}{7} \times \bigg ( 4 - \dfrac{1}{5} \bigg ) \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{1}{7} \times \bigg ( \dfrac{4 \times 5}{5}  - \dfrac{1}{5} \bigg ) \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{1}{7} \times \bigg ( \dfrac{20}{5}  - \dfrac{1}{5} \bigg ) \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{1}{7} \times \bigg ( \dfrac{20 - 1}{5} \bigg ) \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{1}{7} \times  \dfrac{19}{5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{19}{7 \times 5}  \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{19}{35}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\dfrac{19}{35}$

Write down a fraction between nine fifths and two.

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write down a fraction between nine fifths and two.

\end{aligned}

$\dfrac{1}{7} \div \dfrac{4}{3}$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {7} \div \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {7} \times \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1 \times 3} {7 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {28}
\end{aligned}
$

\end{aligned}

**Question**

Write down a fraction which is greater than two fifths, but less than four fifths.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {2} {5} + \dfrac {4} {5} \bigg) \\\\

&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {6} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {6} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 3} {\cancel{2} \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write down a decimal between $\dfrac{2}{5}$ and $\dfrac{1}{2}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg ( {\dfrac {2} {5} + \dfrac {1} {2}} \bigg ) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg ( {\dfrac {2 \times 2} {5 \times 2} + \dfrac {1 \times 5} {2 \times 5}}\bigg ) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg ( {\dfrac {4} {10} + \dfrac {5} {10}} \bigg )\\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg ( {\dfrac {4 + 5} {10}} \bigg )\\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {9} {10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {20} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 \times 5} {20 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {45} {100} \\\\
&= 0.45
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg ( {\dfrac {2 \times 2} {5 \times 2} + \dfrac {1 \times 5} {2 \times 5}}\bigg ) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg ( {\dfrac {4} {10} + \dfrac {5} {10}} \bigg )\\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg ( {\dfrac {4 + 5} {10}} \bigg )\\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out, simplifying your answer if possible

$\dfrac{3}{8}-\dfrac{1}{24}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out, simplifying your answer if possible
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{3}{8}-\dfrac{1}{24}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {3} {8} - \dfrac {1} {24} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 3} {8 \times 3} - \dfrac {1} {24} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {24} - \dfrac {1} {24} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 - 1} {24} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8} {24} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8} {3 \times 8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{8}} {3 \times \cancel{8}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {3}$

</div>

**Question**

What fraction of this flag has been shaded? Give the fraction as simply as possible.

![papers/reigate-grammar-school/2011/sample-paper-2/s01-q22-i00.png](/assets/papers/reigate-grammar-school/2011/sample-paper-2/s01-q22-i00.png "papers/reigate-grammar-school/2011/sample-paper-2/s01-q22-i00.png")

</div>

</code></pre>

                                &= \dfrac{3}{8}
\end{aligned}
$

$\dfrac{2}{9}-\dfrac{4}{27}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= \dfrac {6 - 4} {27} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {27}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find one ninth of $360$.

Use your answer to find four ninths of $360$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find one ninth of $360$.
<emptyline>
Use your answer to find four ninths of $360$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {9} \ \text{of} \ 360 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {9} \times 360 \\\\
&= \dfrac {360} {9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {40 \times 9} {9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {40 \times \cancel{9}} {\cancel{9}} \\\\
&= 40
\end{aligned}
$

Let's use the answer above.

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {4} {9} \ \text{of} \ 360 \\\\
&= \dfrac {4} {9} \times 360 \\\\
&= 4 \times \dfrac {1} {9} \times 360 \\\\
&= 4 \times 40 \\\\
&= 160
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Add together $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of $24$, $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of $30$ and $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of $15$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Add together $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of $24$, $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of $30$ and $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of $15$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \text{ of } 24 + \dfrac {2} {5} \text{ of } 30 + \dfrac {1} {3} \text{ of } 15 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times 24 + \dfrac {2} {5} \times 30 + \dfrac {1} {3} \times 15 \\\\
&= \dfrac {24} {4} + \dfrac {2 \times 30} {5} + \dfrac {15} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {6 \times 4} {4} + \dfrac {2 \times 6 \times 5} {5} + \dfrac {5 \times 3} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} + \dfrac {2 \times 6 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}} + \dfrac {5 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 6 + 12 + 5 \\\\
&= 23
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
