<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out:

$\dfrac{7}{15}-\dfrac{2}{5}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out:
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{7}{15}-\dfrac{2}{5}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {7} {15} - \dfrac {2} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7} {15} - \dfrac {2 \times 3} {5 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7} {15} - \dfrac {6} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 - 6} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {15}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

**Question**

Find one seventh of $280$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

&= 40
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What fraction of this flag is shaded?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What fraction of this flag is shaded?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total boxes}     &= 6 \times 5 \\\\
                       &= 30 \\\\
\text{Shaded boxes}    &= 4 \times 3 \\\\
                        &= 12 \\\\
\text{Fraction shaded} &= \dfrac{12}{30} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{2 \times 6}{5 \times 6} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{2 \times \cancel{6}}{5 \times \cancel{6}} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac{2}{5}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {2} {5}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**


How many more rectangles need to be shaded to fill $\dfrac{4}{5}$ of the flag?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">
How many more rectangles need to be shaded to fill $\dfrac{4}{5}$ of the flag?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Extra rectangles}                            &= \dfrac {4} {5} \times 30 - 12 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {4 \times 30} {5} - 12 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {4 \times 6 \times 5} {5} - 12 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {4 \times 6 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}} - 12 \\\\
                                                     &= 24 - 12 \\\\
                                                     &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**


Which of these is the smallest fraction? Circle your answer.
 
$\dfrac{3}{4} \quad \dfrac{2}{3} \quad \dfrac{5}{12} \quad \dfrac{9}{4}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">
Which of these is the smallest fraction? Circle your answer.
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{3}{4} \quad \dfrac{2}{3} \quad \dfrac{5}{12} \quad \dfrac{9}{4}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's make the denominator the same for all the fractions.

LCM of $4, 3$ and $12 = 12$

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{3}{4}, \quad \dfrac{2}{3}, \quad \dfrac{5}{12}, \quad \dfrac{9}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 3} {4 \times 3}, \quad \dfrac {2 \times 4} {3 \times 4}, \quad \dfrac {5} {12}, \quad \dfrac {9 \times 3} {4 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {12}, \quad \dfrac {8} {12}, \quad \dfrac {5} {12}, \quad \dfrac {27} {12}
\end{aligned}
$

Smallest fraction $= \dfrac {5} {12}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {5} {12}$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let's make the denominator the same for all the fractions.

<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{3}{4}, \quad \dfrac{2}{3}, \quad \dfrac{5}{12}, \quad \dfrac{9}{4} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which of these fractions is the biggest? Circle your answer.

$\dfrac{1+2}{2+3} \quad \dfrac{2+4}{2+3} \quad \dfrac{1+2}{4+6} \quad \dfrac{3+4}{2+3} \quad \dfrac{1+4}{1+3}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which of these fractions is the biggest? Circle your answer.
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{1+2}{2+3} \quad \dfrac{2+4}{2+3} \quad \dfrac{1+2}{4+6} \quad \dfrac{3+4}{2+3} \quad \dfrac{1+4}{1+3}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{1+2}{2+3} , \quad \dfrac{2+4}{2+3} , \quad \dfrac{1+2}{4+6}, \quad \dfrac{3+4}{2+3}, \quad \dfrac{1+4}{1+3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3}{5} , \quad \dfrac{6}{5} , \quad \dfrac{3}{10}, \quad \dfrac{7}{5}, \quad \dfrac{5}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 4}{5 \times 4} , \quad \dfrac{6 \times 4}{5 \times 4} , \quad \dfrac{3 \times 2}{10 \times 2}, \quad \dfrac{7 \times 4}{5 \times 4}, \quad \dfrac{5 \times 5}{4 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{12}{20} , \quad \dfrac{24}{20} , \quad \dfrac{6}{20}, \quad \dfrac{28}{20}, \quad \dfrac{25}{20}
\end{aligned}
$

Biggest Fraction $= \dfrac{28}{20} = \dfrac{3+4}{2+3}$
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Using our previous answer,

$\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {5} {6} \ \text{of} \ 240 \\\\

&= 5 \times 40 \\\\
&= 200
\end{aligned}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Add together 

$20 \%$ of $40$ 

$\dfrac{2} {5}$ of $20$

and $\dfrac{2} {3}$ of $21$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>

<emptyline>

</code></pre>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
&= 20 \% \text{ of } 40 + \dfrac {2} {5} \text{ of } 20 + \dfrac {2} {3} \text{ of } 21 \\\\
&= \dfrac {20} {100} \times 40 + \dfrac {2} {5} \times 20 + \dfrac {2} {3} \times 21 \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 40} {100} + \dfrac {2 \times 20} {5} + \dfrac {2 \times 21} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 40} {100} + \dfrac {2 \times 4 \times 5} {5} + \dfrac {2 \times 7 \times 3} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \cancel{0} \times 4 \cancel{0}} {1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0}} + \dfrac {2 \times 4 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}} + \dfrac {2 \times 7 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 8 + 8 + 14 \\\\
&= 30
\end{aligned}$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out

$\dfrac{2} {5} + \dfrac {2} {15}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2} {5} + \dfrac {2} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {5 \times 3} + \dfrac {2} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac {6} {15} + \dfrac {2} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac {6 + 2} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8} {15}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\dfrac {8} {15}$

</div>

$\dfrac{3}{8}\div\dfrac{1}{4}$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= \dfrac {3} {8} \div \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {8} \times 4 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 4} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 4} {2 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel{4}} {2 \times \cancel{4}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

Calculate $5\dfrac{3}{8}-2\dfrac{1}{4}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $5\dfrac{3}{8}-2\dfrac{1}{4}$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

\begin{aligned}
&= 5 \dfrac {3} {8} - 2 \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {43} {8} - \dfrac {9} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {43} {8} - \dfrac {9 \times 2} {4 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {43} {8} - \dfrac {18} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {43 - 18} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {25} {8} \\\\
&= 3 \dfrac {1} {8}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $3\dfrac{5}{6}+4\dfrac{2}{3}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $3\dfrac{5}{6}+4\dfrac{2}{3}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \dfrac {5} {6} + 4 \dfrac {2} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {23} {6} + \dfrac {14} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {23} {6} + \dfrac {14 \times 2} {3 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {23} {6} + \dfrac {28} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {23 + 28} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {51} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 17} {3 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 17} {\cancel{3} \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {17} {2} \\\\
&= 8 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

 Calculate $4\dfrac{2}{3}-1\dfrac{1}{4}$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex"> Calculate $4\dfrac{2}{3}-1\dfrac{1}{4}$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 4 \dfrac {2} {3} - 1 \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {14} {3} - \dfrac {5} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {14 \times 4} {3 \times 4} - \dfrac {5 \times 3} {4 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {56} {12} - \dfrac {15} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {56 - 15} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {41} {12} \\\\
&= 3 \dfrac {5} {12}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $4\dfrac{3}{7}+2\dfrac{5}{6}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $4\dfrac{3}{7}+2\dfrac{5}{6}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 4 \dfrac {3} {7} + 2 \dfrac {5} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {31} {7} + \dfrac {17} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {31 \times 6} {7 \times 6} + \dfrac {17 \times 7} {6 \times 7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {186} {42} + \dfrac {119} {42} \\\\
&= \dfrac {186 + 119} {42} \\\\
&= \dfrac {305} {42} \\\\
&= 7 \dfrac {11} {42}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 4\dfrac {3}{7} + 2\dfrac {5}{6} \\\\
&= (4 + 2) + \bigg( \dfrac {3}{7} + \dfrac {5}{6} \bigg) \\\\
&= 6 + \bigg( \dfrac {3 \times 6} {7 \times 6} + \dfrac {5 \times 7} {6 \times 7} \bigg) \\\\
&= 6 + \bigg( \dfrac {18} {42} + \dfrac {35} {42} \bigg) \\\\
&= 6 + \dfrac {18 + 35} {42} \\\\
&= 6 + \dfrac {53} {42} \\\\
&= 6 + 1\dfrac {11}{42} \\\\
&= 7\dfrac {11}{42}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7 \dfrac {11} {42}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $4\dfrac{1}{4}-2\dfrac{1}{2}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $4\dfrac{1}{4}-2\dfrac{1}{2}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= 4 \dfrac {1} {4} - 2 \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {17} {4} - \dfrac {5} {2} \\\\

&= \dfrac {17} {4} - \dfrac {10} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {17 - 10} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7} {4} \\\\
&= 1 \dfrac {3} {4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What fraction of $2.4 \ \text{litres}$ is $400 \ \text{ml} \text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What fraction of $2.4 \ \text{litres}$ is $400 \ \text{ml} \text{?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction} &= \dfrac {400  \ \text{ml}} {2.4 \ \text{litres}} \\\\\
                &= \dfrac {400  \ \text{ml}} {2.4 \times 1000 \ \text{ml}} \\\\\
                &= \dfrac {400} {24 \times 100} \\\\\
                &= \dfrac {4 \times 100} {4 \times 6 \times 100} \\\\\
                &= \dfrac {\cancel{4} \times 1\cancel{0}\cancel{0}} {\cancel{4} \times 6 \times 1\cancel{0}\cancel{0}} \\\\\
                &= \dfrac{1}{6}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {6}$

</div>

**Question**

$\dfrac {3} {4} + \dfrac {1}{3}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac {3} {4} + \dfrac {1}{3}$
</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}

&= \dfrac {3 \times 3} {4 \times 3} + \dfrac {1 \times 4} {3 \times 4} \\\\

&= \dfrac {9 + 4} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {13} {12} \\\\
&= 1 \dfrac {1} {12}
\end{aligned}
$

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the diagram the small squares are all the same size. What fraction of the large square is shaded?

![papers/sevenoaks-school/2015/sample-paper-6/s01-q14-i00.png](/assets/papers/sevenoaks-school/2015/sample-paper-6/s01-q14-i00.png "papers/sevenoaks-school/2015/sample-paper-6/s01-q14-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the figure,

If we look at the large square, we can see that $8$ portions have been shaded and there are $18$ portions in total.

The fraction that has been shaded $= \dfrac {8} {18}$

Let's find out what fraction of the large square is shaded.

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {8} {18} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 2} {9 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel{2}} {9 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4} {9}
\end{aligned}
$

Fraction of large square that has been shaded in simple fraction $= \dfrac {4} {9}$
</div>

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mr Shah had $15\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{m}$ of wire. He cut off a piece of wire $2\dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{m}$ long. How much wire did he have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mr Shah had $15\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{m}$ of wire. He cut off a piece of wire $2\dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{m}$ long. How much wire did he have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Left over}                  &= \ \text {Total length} - \text {Length cut off} \\\\
                                   &= 15 \dfrac {1} {2}  - 2 \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {31} {2} - \dfrac {11} {4} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {31 \times 2} {2  \times 2} - \dfrac {11} {4} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {62} {4} - \dfrac {11} {4} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {62 - 11} {4} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {51} {4} \\\\
                                   &= 12 \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12 \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{m}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Dan has to walk $1\dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{km}$ to school. How far has he walked when he is halfway?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Dan has to walk $1\dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{km}$ to school. How far has he walked when he is halfway?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Halfway distance}                  &= 1 \dfrac {3} {4} \div 2 \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7} {4} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7} {4 \times 2} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7} {8} \ \text{km} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7} {8} \times 1000 \ \text{metres} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7 \times 1000}{8} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7 \times 125 \times 8}{8} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7 \times 125 \times \cancel{8}}{\cancel{8}} \\\\
                                         &= 7 \times 125 \\\\
                                         &= 875 \text{ metres}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$875 \text{ metres}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$

                                         &= \dfrac {7} {4} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7} {4 \times 2} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7} {8} \ \text{km} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7} {8} \times 1000 \ \text{metres} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7 \times 1000}{8} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7 \times 125 \times 8}{8} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {7 \times 125 \times \cancel{8}}{\cancel{8}} \\\\
                                         &= 7 \times 125 \\\\
                                         &= 875 \text{ metres}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac {3} {5} + \dfrac {2} {10}$
</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}

&= \dfrac {3} {5} + \dfrac {2} {2 \times 5} \\\\

&= \dfrac {3} {5} + \dfrac {1} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 + 1} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much larger is $7 \dfrac {4} {5}$ than $3\dfrac {2} {5} \text{?}$   

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much larger is $7 \dfrac {4} {5}$ than $3\dfrac {2} {5} \text{?}$   
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 7 \dfrac {4} {5} - 3 \dfrac {2} {5}\\\\
&= \dfrac {39} {5} - \dfrac {17} {5}  \\\\
&= \dfrac {39 - 17} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {22} {5} \\\\
&= 4 \dfrac {2} {5}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= 7 - 3 + \dfrac {4} {5} - \dfrac {2} {5} \\\\
&= 7 - 3 + \dfrac {4 - 2} {5}  \\\\
&= 4 + \dfrac {2} {5} \\\\
&= 4 \dfrac {2} {5}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

$4 \dfrac {2} {5}$

                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 5} {\cancel{2} \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5} {2} \\\\
                        &= 2 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Fill in three missing numbers to make these four fractions equivalent.

$\dfrac {4} {\phantom{77}} = \dfrac {\phantom{77}} {10} = \dfrac {12} {15} = \dfrac {20} {\phantom{77}}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Fill in three missing numbers to make these four fractions equivalent.
<emptyline>
$\dfrac {4} {\phantom{77}} = \dfrac {\phantom{77}} {10} = \dfrac {12} {15} = \dfrac {20} {\phantom{77}}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing numbers $= a, b, c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {4} {a}      &= \dfrac {12} {15} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {15 \times 4} {12} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 4} {4 \times 3} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel {3} \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4} \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
a                   &= 5 \\\\
\dfrac {b} {10}     &= \dfrac {12} {15} \\\\
b                   &= \dfrac {12 \times 10} {15} \\\\
b                   &= \dfrac {4 \times 3 \times 5 \times 2} {5 \times 3} \\\\
b                   &= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel {3} \times \cancel {5} \times 2} {\cancel {5} \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
b                   &= 4 \times 2 \\\\
b                   &= 8 \\\\
\dfrac {20} {c}     &= \dfrac {12} {15} \\\\
c                   &= \dfrac {15 \times 20} {12} \\\\
c                   &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 4 \times 5} {4 \times 3} \\\\
c                   &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel {3} \times \cancel {4} \times 5} {\cancel {4} \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
c                   &= 5 \times 5 \\\\
c                   &= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $\dfrac {1} {3}$  of $\dfrac {1} {4}$ of $\dfrac {1} {5}$ of $360 \text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $\dfrac {1} {3}$  of $\dfrac {1} {4}$ of $\dfrac {1} {5}$ of $360 \text{?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {3} \ \text{of} \ \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text{of} \ \dfrac {1} {5} \ \text{of} \ 360 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {4} \times \dfrac {1} {5} \times 360\\\\
&= \dfrac {360} {3 \times 4 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 5 \times 6} {3 \times 4 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times \cancel{4} \times \cancel{5} \times 6} {\cancel{3} \times \cancel{4} \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
&= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>
$\dfrac {} {8} = \dfrac {9} {12} = \dfrac {21} {}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing numerator $= a$

Let the missing denominator $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{a} {8}               &= \dfrac {9} {12} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {9 \times 8} {12} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {3 \times 3 \times 4 \times 2} {4 \times 3} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel{3} \times \cancel{4} \times 2} {\cancel{4} \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
a                           &= 3 \times 2 \\\\
a                           &= 6 \\\\
\dfrac {21} {b}             &= \dfrac {9} {12} \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {21 \times 12} {9} \\\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {3 \times 7 \times 4 \times 3} {3 \times 3} \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 7 \times 4 \times \cancel{3}}{\cancel{3} \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
b                           &= 7 \times 4 \\\\
b                           &= 28
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $\dfrac {2} {3}$  of a  number is $14$,  what  is the   number? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $\dfrac {2} {3}$  of a  number is $14$,  what  is the   number? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {2} {3} \times a           &= 14 \\\\
a                                 &= \dfrac {14 \times 3} {2} \\\\
a                                 &= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
a                                 &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {2} \times 3}{\cancel {2}} \\\\
a                                 &= 7 \times{3} \\\\
a                                 &= 21
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find $\dfrac{5}{8}$ of $240 \ \text{m}$.
      

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $\dfrac{5}{8}$ of $240 \ \text{m}$.
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {5}{8} \text{ of } {240} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 240} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 8 \times 30} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel{8} \times 30} {\cancel{8}} \\\\
&= 5 \times 30 \\\\
&= 150 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$2 \dfrac{1}{2} + 4 \dfrac{1}{4}$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$2 \dfrac{1}{2} + 4 \dfrac{1}{4}$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 2\dfrac {1}{2} +4\dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{5}{2} + \dfrac{17}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 2} {2 \times 2} + \dfrac {17} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {10} {4} + \dfrac {17} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{10+17}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{27}{4} \\\\
&= 6\dfrac{3}{4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 2\dfrac {1}{2} +4\dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
&= 2 + 4 + \dfrac {1}{2} + \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
&= 6 + \dfrac {1 \times 2} {2 \times 2} + \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
&= 6 + \dfrac {2} {4} + \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
&= 6 + \dfrac {2 + 1} {4}  \\\\
&= 6 + \dfrac {3} {4}  \\\\
&= 6 \dfrac{3}{4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6\dfrac{3}{4}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3\dfrac {2}{5} + 2\dfrac {3}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {17}{5}  + \dfrac {11}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {17 \times 4}{5 \times 4}  + \dfrac {11 \times 5}{4 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {68}{20}  + \dfrac {55}{20} \\\\
&= \dfrac {68 + 55}{20} \\\\
&= \dfrac {123}{20} \\\\
&= 6 \dfrac {3}{20}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= 5 + \dfrac {8 + 15} {20} \\\\
&= 5 + \dfrac {23} {20} \\\\
&= 5 + 1\dfrac {3}{20} \\\\
&= 6\dfrac {3}{20}
\end{aligned}
$

\begin{aligned}
&=  1\dfrac {2} {3} \div \dfrac {10} {21} \\\\
&=  \dfrac {5} {3} \div \dfrac {10} {21} \\\\
&=  \dfrac {5} {3} \times \dfrac {21} {10} \\\\
&=  \dfrac {5 \times 21} {3 \times 10}  \\\\
&=  \dfrac {5 \times 7 \times 3} {3 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
&=  \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 7 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3} \times 2 \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
&=  \dfrac {7}{2} \\\\
&=  3 \dfrac {1}{2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{1} {3} \times 60  &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times c \\\\
\dfrac{2} {3} \times c   &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times 60 \\\\
c                        &= \dfrac {60 \times 3} {3 \times 2} \\\\
c                        &= \dfrac {30 \times 2 \times 3} {3 \times 2} \\\\
c                        &= \dfrac {30 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3} \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
c                        &= 30
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find the missing numerator and denominator of the equivalent fractions below:

$\dfrac{\phantom{11}}{12} = \dfrac{12}{18} = \dfrac{18}{\phantom{11}}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the missing numerator and denominator of the equivalent fractions below:
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{\phantom{11}}{12} = \dfrac{12}{18} = \dfrac{18}{\phantom{11}}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing numerator $= a$

Let the missing denominator $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a} {12}                     &= \dfrac {12} {18} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {12 \times 12} {18} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 6} {3 \times 6} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel{3} \times 2 \times \cancel{6}} {\cancel{3} \times \cancel{6}} \\\\
a                                   &= 4 \times 2 \\\\
a                                   &= 8 \\\\
\dfrac {18} {b}                     &= \dfrac {12} {18} \\\\
b                                   &= \dfrac {18 \times 18} {12} \\\\
b                                   &= \dfrac {6 \times 3 \times 9 \times 2} {6 \times 2} \\\\
b                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel{6} \times 3 \times 9 \times \cancel{2}} {\cancel{6} \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
b                                   &= 3 \times 9 \\\\
b                                   &= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

![papers/sydenham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q17-i00.png](/assets/papers/sydenham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q17-i00.png "papers/sydenham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q17-i00.png")

This diagram is made up of $7$ identical regular hexagons and $12$ identical equilateral triangles.

Note: the sides of the triangles are the same length as the sides of the hexagons.

Find the fraction of the diagram that is shaded. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%image%
<emptyline>

<emptyline>
Note: the sides of the triangles are the same length as the sides of the hexagons.
<emptyline>
Find the fraction of the diagram that is shaded. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {\text {Shaded portion} } {\text {Total portion} } \\\\
&= \dfrac {7} {12 + 7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7} {19}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write down any fraction between $\dfrac{1}{3}$ and $\dfrac{1}{2}$ .

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write down any fraction between $\dfrac{1}{3}$ and $\dfrac{1}{2}$ .
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {1} {3} + \dfrac{1} {2} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {1 \times 2} {3 \times 2} + \dfrac {1 \times 3} {2 \times 3} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {2} {6} + \dfrac {3} {6} \bigg) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \bigg( \dfrac {2 + 3} {6} \bigg)  \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2}  \times \dfrac {5} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5} {12}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {5} {12}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which one of the following fractions is **not** equivalent to $\dfrac{3}{5}$.

$\dfrac{12}{20}, \quad \dfrac{30}{50}, \quad \dfrac{18}{30}, \quad \dfrac{21}{35}, \quad \dfrac{9}{25}, \quad \dfrac{27}{45}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which one of the following fractions is **not** equivalent to $\dfrac{3}{5}$.
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{12}{20}, \quad \dfrac{30}{50}, \quad \dfrac{18}{30}, \quad \dfrac{21}{35}, \quad \dfrac{9}{25}, \quad \dfrac{27}{45}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {12} {20}, \quad \dfrac {30} {50}, \quad \dfrac {18} {30}, \quad \dfrac {21} {35}, \quad \dfrac {9} {25}, \quad \dfrac {27} {45} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 3} {4 \times 5}, \quad \dfrac {30} {50}, \quad \dfrac {6 \times 3} {6 \times 5}, \quad \dfrac {7 \times 3} {7 \times 5}, \quad \dfrac {9} {25}, \quad \dfrac {9 \times 3} {9 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {4} \times 3} {\cancel {4} \times 5}, \quad \dfrac {3 \cancel {0}} {5 \cancel {0}} , \quad \dfrac {\cancel {6} \times 3} {\cancel {6} \times 5}, \quad \dfrac {\cancel {7} \times 3} {\cancel {7} \times 5}, \quad \dfrac {9} {25}, \quad \dfrac {\cancel {9} \times 3} {\cancel {9} \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5} , \quad \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {9} {25}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= \dfrac {9} {25}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {9} {25}$

</div>
</div>

&= \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5} , \quad \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {9} {25}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find the difference between $43 \dfrac{1}{3}$ and $51 \dfrac{2}{3}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the difference between $43 \dfrac{1}{3}$ and $51 \dfrac{2}{3}$.
</code></pre>

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 51 \dfrac {2} {3} - 43 \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {155} {3} - \dfrac {130} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {155 - 130} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {25} {3} \\\\
&= 8 \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$

&= 8 + \dfrac {2 - 1} {3} \\\\
&= 8 + \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
&= 8 \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is a half of three-quarters?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is a half of three-quarters?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \text{half of three-quarters} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {2 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {8}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

\begin{aligned}
\text{Not shaded}   &= \dfrac {3} {6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3} {3 \times 2} \\\\

**Working**

Given that,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Right-handed players in Team Alpha} \ &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Left-handed players in Team Beta} \ &= 2
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total left-handed players} \ &= 6 \\\\
\text{Total left-handed players} &= \text{Left-handed players in Team Beta} + \text{Left-handed players in Team Alpha} \\\\
2 + \text{Left-handed players in Team Alpha} &= 6 \\\\
\text{Left-handed players in Team Alpha} &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total players in Team Alpha} \ &= \text{Left-handed players in Team Alpha} + \text{Right-handed players in Team Alpha} \\\\
\text{Total players in Team Alpha} \ &= 4 + 7 \\\\
\text{Total players in Team Alpha} \ &= 11
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Left-handed players in Team Beta} + \text{Right-handed players in Team Beta} &= \text{Total players in Team Beta} \ \\\\
\text{Left-handed players in Team Beta} + \text{Right-handed players in Team Beta} &= 11 \\\\
2 + \text{Right-handed players in Team Beta} &= 11 \\\\
\text{Right-handed players in Team Beta} &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total players playing} &= \text{Total players in Team Alpha} + \text{Total players in Team Beta} \\\\
\text{Total players playing} &= 11 + 11 \\\\
\text{Total players playing} &= 22
\end{aligned}
$

\end{aligned}

$
\dfrac{2}{3} > \dfrac{3}{5}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

These are called nested squares. What fraction of this shape is shaded in?

![papers/the-kings-school-chester/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q25-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-kings-school-chester/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q25-i00.png "papers/the-kings-school-chester/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q25-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">These are called nested squares. What fraction of this shape is shaded in?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Let the side of the square} \ &= s
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Let the area of the square} \ &= a \\\\
                                     &= s^2
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Let the side of inner square} \ &= x
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Let the area of inner square} \ &= b \\\\
                                       &= x^2
\end{aligned}
$

By pythogoras theorem,

$
\begin{aligned}
(\dfrac{s}{2})^2 + (\dfrac{s}{2})^2 &= x^2 \\\\
\dfrac{s^2}{4} + \dfrac{s^2}{4} &= x^2 \\\\
\dfrac{s^2}{2} &= x^2 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{a}{2}
\end{aligned}
$

Area of inner square $= \dfrac{a}{2}$

Following the similiar pattern,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Area of shaded region} \ &= \dfrac{a}{2} - \dfrac{a}{4} + \dfrac{a}{8} - \dfrac{a}{16} + \dfrac{a}{32} \\\\
&= \dfrac{11a}{32}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Fraction of shaded region over total area} \ &= \dfrac{ \dfrac{11a}{32} }{a} \\\\
&= \dfrac{11}{32}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{11}{32}$

</div>

b &= \dfrac{a}{2}
\end{aligned}

<emptyline>

\begin{aligned}

&= \dfrac{11a}{32}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Fraction of shaded region over total area} \ &= \dfrac{ \dfrac{11a}{32} }{a} \\\\
&= \dfrac{11}{32}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $\dfrac {2} {7}$ of $315?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $\dfrac {2} {7}$ of $315?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2} {7} \text { of } 315 \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {7} \times 315 \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 315} {7}   \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 45 \times 7} {7}   \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 45 \times \cancel{7}} {\cancel{7}}   \\\\
&= 2 \times 45  \\\\
&= 90
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

\text {Fraction} &= \dfrac {\text {Green marbles}} {\text {Remaining marbles}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5} {11 - 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5} {9}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

\text{Shaded Area} &= 4 \ \text{unit}^2 \\\\
\text{Fraction Shaded} &= \dfrac{4}{16} \\\\
&= \dfrac{1 \times \cancel 4}{4 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{1}{4}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of $48$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of $48$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {3} {8} \text{ of } 48 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {8} \times 48 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 48} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 6 \times 8} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 6 \times \cancel{8}} {\cancel{8}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 6 \\\\
&= 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find $\dfrac{1}{7}$ of $35$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $\dfrac{1}{7}$ of $35$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {7} \text{ of } 35 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {7} \times 35 \\\\
&= \dfrac {35} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac { 5 \times 7} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac { 5 \times \cancel{7}} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
&= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find $\dfrac{3}{7}$ of $35$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $\dfrac{3}{7}$ of $35$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {3} {7} \text{ of } 35 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {7} \times 35 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 35} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 5 \times 7} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 5 \times \cancel{7}} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 5  \\\\
&= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

What is $\dfrac{3}{7}$  of $385?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

&= \dfrac {3} {7} \ \text {of} \ 385 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {7} \times 385 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 385} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 55 \times 7} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 55 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 55 \\\\
&= 165
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total boxes}      &= 3 \times 4 + 1 + 1 + 4 \times \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                        &= 12 + 2 + 2 \\\\

                        &= 6 + 2 + 4 \\\\

                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 4} {4 \times 4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {4}} {4 \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3} {4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total boxes}      &= 3 \times 4 + 1 + 1 + 4 \times \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                        &= 12 + 2 + 2 \\\\
                        &= 16 \\\\
\text{Shaded boxes}     &= 3 \times 2 + 1 + 1 + 8 \times \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                        &= 6 + 2 + 4 \\\\
                        &= 12 \\\\
\text{Fraction shaded}  &= \dfrac{12}{16} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 4} {4 \times 4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {4}} {4 \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3} {4}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $\dfrac{5}{8}$ of $48$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

&= \dfrac {2 \times 18 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 2 \times 18 \\\\
&= 36
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Work out $\dfrac{3}{5}$ of $45$.

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

&=  3 \times 9 \\\\
&=  27
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Which is larger, $75\%$ or $\dfrac{5}{8}?$

Give a reason for your answer.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which is larger, $75\%$ or $\dfrac{5}{8}?$
<emptyline>
Give a reason for your answer.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 75\% or \dfrac{5}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{75}{100} or \dfrac{5}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{25 \times 3}{25 \times 4} or \dfrac{5}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel{25} \times 3}{\cancel{25} \times 4} or \dfrac{5}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3}{4} is greater than \dfrac{5}{8}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$75\%$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $72$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $72$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text {of} \ 72 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {4} \times 72 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 72}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 18 \times 4} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 18 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 18 \\\\
&= 54
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$54$

</div>

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{3}{8} \ \text{of}\ 72 \\\\
&= \dfrac{3}{8} \times 72 \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 72}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 9 \times 8} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 9 \times \cancel{8}} {\cancel{8}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 9 \\\\
&= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $96$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text {of} \ 96 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {4} \times 96 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 96} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 24 \times 4} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 24 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 24 \\\\
&= 72
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the difference between a tenth of $5$ and a fifth of $10$? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the difference between a tenth of $5$ and a fifth of $10$? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Difference}  &=  \dfrac {1} {5} \ \text {of} \ 10 - \dfrac {1} {10} \ \text {of} \ 5 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {5} \times 10 - \dfrac {1} {10} \times 5 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {10} {5} - \dfrac {5} {10} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {5 \times 2} {5} - \dfrac {5} {5 \times 2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 2} {\cancel{5}} - \dfrac {\cancel{5}} {\cancel{5} \times 2} \\\\
                    &= 2 - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1 \times 2} {2} - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {2} {2} - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {2 - 1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
                    &= 1 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1 \dfrac {1} {2}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Difference}  &=  \dfrac {1} {5} \ \text {of} \ 10 - \dfrac {1} {10} \ \text {of} \ 5 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {5} \times 10 - \dfrac {1} {10} \times 5 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {10} {5} - \dfrac {5} {10} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {5 \times 2} {5} - \dfrac {5} {5 \times 2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 2} {\cancel{5}} - \dfrac {\cancel{5}} {\cancel{5} \times 2} \\\\
                    &= 2 - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1 \times 2} {2} - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {2} {2} - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {2 - 1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
                    &= 1 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $\dfrac{5}{7}$ of $84$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

&=  \dfrac {5 \times 12 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
&=  5 \times 12 \\\\
&=  60
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $22\dfrac{1}{2} \div 5$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $22\dfrac{1}{2} \div 5$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned} 
&= 22 \dfrac{1}{2} \div 5 \\\\ 
&= \dfrac {45}{2} \times \dfrac {1}{5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {45} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 \times 5} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel{5}} {2 \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {2} \\\\
&= 4 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4 \dfrac{1}{2}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write $0.36$ as a fraction in its simplest form.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write $0.36$ as a fraction in its simplest form.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= 0.36 \\\\
&= \dfrac {36} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 9} {4 \times 25} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{4} \times 9} {\cancel{4} \times 25} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9} {25}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much is $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of $\pounds 1?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much is $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of $\pounds 1?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{3}{4} \text{ of } \dfrac{2}{5} \text{ of } \pounds 1 \\\\
&= \dfrac{3}{4} \times  \dfrac{2}{5} \times 100 \ \text{pence} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3}{4} \times \dfrac{2}{5} \times 100 \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 2 \times 100} {4 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 2 \times 4 \times 5 \times 5} {4 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 2 \times \cancel{4} \times \cancel{5} \times 5} {\cancel{4} \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 2  \times 5 \\\\
&= 30 \ \text{pence}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$30 \ \text{pence}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $2 \dfrac{2}{5} + 3 \dfrac{3}{10}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $2 \dfrac{2}{5} + 3 \dfrac{3}{10}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 2 \dfrac {2} {5} + 3 \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {12} {5} + \dfrac{33}{10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {12 \times 2} {5 \times 2} + \dfrac {33} {10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {24} {10}+ \dfrac {33} {10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {24 + 33} {10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {57} {10} \\\\
&= {5} \dfrac {7} {10}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
