<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 2\dfrac {2}{5} + 3\dfrac {3}{10} \\\\
&= 2 + 3 + \dfrac {2}{5} + \dfrac {3}{10} \\\\
&= 5 + \dfrac {2 \times 2} {5 \times 2} + \dfrac {3}{10} \\\\
&= 5 + \dfrac {4} {10} + \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
&= 5 + \dfrac {4 + 3} {10} \\\\
&= 5 + \dfrac {7} {10} \\\\
&= 5\dfrac {7}{10}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

${5} \dfrac {7} {10}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $\dfrac{5}{6}$ of $48$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $\dfrac{5}{6}$ of $48$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{of} \ \dfrac {5} {6} \ \text{of} \ 48 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {4} \times \dfrac {5} {6} \times 48 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 5 \times 48} {4 \times 6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 5 \times 4 \times 2 \times 6} {4 \times 6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 5 \times \cancel{4} \times 2 \times \cancel{6}} {\cancel{4} \times \cancel{6}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 5 \times 2 \\\\
&= 30
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $17 \dfrac{1}{2} \div 5$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $17 \dfrac{1}{2} \div 5$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 17 \dfrac{1}{2} \div 5 \\\\
&= \dfrac {35} {2} \div 5 \\\\
&= \dfrac {35} {2} \times \dfrac {1} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {35} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 5} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel{5}} {2 \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7} {2} \\\\
&= 3 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$3\dfrac{1}{2}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write $0.64$ as a fraction in its simplest form.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What fraction of a day is $9 \ \text{hours}$? Write your fraction in its simplest form.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What fraction of a day is $9 \ \text{hours}$? Write your fraction in its simplest form.
</code></pre>

&= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 3} {\cancel{3} \times 8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {8}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Irfan has six fraction cards as shown below.

$
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{24}} \quad 
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{12}} \quad
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{8}}  \quad 
\boxed{\dfrac {1}{6}} \quad 
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{4}}  \quad 
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{3}}  \quad
$ 

Write down a possible way in which he can add **__three or more__** cards to get the answer $\dfrac{1}{2}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Irfan has six fraction cards as shown below.
<emptyline>
$
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{24}} \quad 
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{12}} \quad
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{8}}  \quad 
\boxed{\dfrac {1}{6}} \quad 
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{4}}  \quad 
\boxed{\dfrac{1}{3}}  \quad
$ 
<emptyline>
Write down a possible way in which he can add **__three or more__** cards to get the answer $\dfrac{1}{2}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

This can be solved by using trial and error.

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{1}{12} + \dfrac{1}{6} + \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2}{2 \times 12} + \dfrac{4}{4 \times 6} + \dfrac{6}{6 \times 4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2}{24} + \dfrac{4}{24} + \dfrac{6}{24} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 + 4 + 6}{24}  \\\\
&= \dfrac{12}{24}  \\\\
&= \dfrac{12}{12 \times 2}  \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel{12}}{\cancel{12} \times 2}  \\\\
&= \dfrac{1}{2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{1}{12} + \dfrac{1}{6} + \dfrac{1}{4}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $5 \dfrac{1}{3} \times 3\dfrac{3}{4}$, giving your answer in its simplest form.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}
$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Subtract $1 \dfrac{3}{4}$ from $3 \dfrac{3}{8}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Subtract $1 \dfrac{3}{4}$ from $3 \dfrac{3}{8}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \dfrac {3} {8} - 1 \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {27} {8} - \dfrac {7} {4} \\\\

&= \dfrac {27} {8} - \dfrac {14} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {27 - 14} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {13} {8} \\\\
&= 1\dfrac {5} {8}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $3 \dfrac{3}{4} \div 2 \dfrac{1}{2}$, giving your answer in its simplest form.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $3 \dfrac{3}{4} \div 2 \dfrac{1}{2}$, giving your answer in its simplest form.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \dfrac {3} {4} \div 2 \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {15} {4} \div \dfrac {5} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {15} {4} \times \dfrac {2} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {15 \times 2} {4 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 2} {2 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 3 \times \cancel{2}} {2 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
&= 1 \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1 \dfrac {1} {2}$

</div>
</div>

</div>

$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $\dfrac {5} {8}$ of $4000$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $\dfrac {5} {8}$ of $4000$.
</code></pre>

&= \dfrac {5} {8} \text{ of } 4000 \\\\
&= \dfrac {5} {8} \times 4000 \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 4000} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 500 \times 8} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 500 \times \cancel {8}} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
&= 5 \times 500 \\\\
&= 2500
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

$6 \dfrac{1} {3} + 9 \dfrac {3} {4}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$6 \dfrac{1} {3} + 9 \dfrac {3} {4}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 6 \dfrac{1} {3} + 9 \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{19} {3} + \dfrac {39} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{19 \times 4} {3 \times 4} + \dfrac {39 \times 3} {4 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{76} {12} + \dfrac {117} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac{76 + 117} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac{193} {12} \\\\
&= 16 \dfrac {1} {12}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= 15 + \bigg( \dfrac {1 \times 4} {3 \times 4} + \dfrac {3 \times 3} {4 \times 3} \bigg) \\\\
&= 15 + \bigg( \dfrac {4} {12} + \dfrac {9} {12} \bigg) \\\\
&= 15 + \bigg( \dfrac {4 + 9} {12} \bigg) \\\\
&= 15 + \dfrac {13} {12} \\\\
&= 15 + 1\dfrac {1}{12} \\\\
&= 16\dfrac {1}{12}
\end{aligned}
$

&= \dfrac {7 \times 864} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 72 \times 12} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 72 \times {\cancel {12}}} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
&= 7 \times 72 \\\\
&= 504
\end{aligned}
$

**[Write your answer as a mixed number]**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 5 \dfrac{2} {3} + 2 \dfrac {3} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{17} {3} + \dfrac {13} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{17 \times 5} {3 \times 5} + \dfrac {13 \times 3} {5 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{85} {15} + \dfrac {39} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac{85 + 39} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac{124} {15} \\\\
&= 8 \dfrac {4} {15}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= 7 + \bigg( \dfrac {2 \times 5} {3 \times 5} + \dfrac {3 \times 3} {5 \times 3} \bigg) \\\\
&= 7 + \bigg( \dfrac {10} {15} + \dfrac {9} {15} \bigg) \\\\
&= 7 + \dfrac {10 + 9} {15} \\\\
&= 7 + \dfrac {19} {15} \\\\
&= 7 + 1\dfrac {4}{15} \\\\
&= 8\dfrac {4}{15}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Pair up the equivalent fractions and write down the odd one out.

$\dfrac {1} {2}\quad\dfrac{2} {3}\quad\dfrac {3} {5}\quad\dfrac {9} {18}\quad\dfrac {10} {15}$


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Pair up the equivalent fractions and write down the odd one out.

<emptyline>
</code></pre>

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2}, \quad \dfrac {2} {3}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {9} {18}, \quad \dfrac {10} {15} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2}, \quad \dfrac {2} {3}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {9} {9 \times 2}, \quad \dfrac {5 \times 2} {5 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2}, \quad \dfrac {2} {3}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {\cancel {9}} {\cancel {9} \times 2}, \quad \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 2} {\cancel {5} \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2}, \quad \dfrac {2} {3}, \quad \dfrac {3} {5}, \quad \dfrac {1} {2}, \quad \dfrac {2} {3} \\\\
&= \bigg ( \dfrac {1} {2}, \quad \dfrac {1} {2} \bigg ), \quad \bigg ( \dfrac {2} {3}, \quad \dfrac {2} {3} \bigg ), \quad \dfrac {3} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

Odd one out $= \dfrac {3} {5} $

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$\dfrac {1} {6}$ of this box of chocolates are white chocolate. If there are $30$ chocolates in the box, how many are white chocolate? 

![papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i00.png "papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i00.png")  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac {1} {6}$ of this box of chocolates are white chocolate. If there are $30$ chocolates in the box, how many are white chocolate? 
<emptyline>
%image%  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of white chocolates} &= \dfrac {1} {6} \times 30 \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {30} {6} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {6 \times 5} {6} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel {6} \times 5} {\cancel {6}} \\\\
                                  &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

</div>

&= \dfrac{4 \times 2} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8} {3} \\\\
&= 2\dfrac{2} {3}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $(40\% \ \text {of} \ 90) + (\dfrac {3} {7} \ \text {of} \ 63)$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $(40\% \ \text {of} \ 90) + (\dfrac {3} {7} \ \text {of} \ 63)$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= (40\% \ \text {of} \ 90) + (\dfrac {3} {7} \ \text {of} \ 63) \\\\
&= \dfrac {40} {100} \times 90 + \dfrac {3} {7} \times 63 \\\\
&= \dfrac {40 \times 90} {100} + \dfrac {3 \times 63} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {40 \times 90} {100} + \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times 7} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \cancel {0} \times 9 \cancel {0}} {1 \cancel {0} \cancel {0}} + \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
&= 4 \times 9 + 3 \times 9 \\\\
&= 36 + 27 \\\\
&= 63
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$63$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
&= (40\% \ \text {of} \ 90) + (\dfrac {3} {7} \ \text {of} \ 63) \\\\
&= \dfrac {40} {100} \times 90 + \dfrac {3} {7} \times 63 \\\\
&= \dfrac {40 \times 90} {100} + \dfrac {3 \times 63} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {40 \times 90} {100} + \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times 7} {7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \cancel {0} \times 9 \cancel {0}} {1 \cancel {0} \cancel {0}} + \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
&= 4 \times 9 + 3 \times 9 \\\\
&= 36 + 27 \\\\
&= 63
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

**Question**

How many green balls must be added to the bag if the fraction of green is now $\dfrac{1}{3}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many green balls must be added to the bag if the fraction of green is now $\dfrac{1}{3}$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of green balls to be added = $a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1 + a} {7 + a}              &= \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
3 \times  ( 1 + a  )                &= 7 + a \\\\
3 + 3a                              &= 7 + a \\\\
3a - a                              &= 7 - 3 \\\\
2a                                  &= 4 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac{4} {2} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac{2 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac{\cancel 2 \times 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                                   &= 2
\end{aligned}
$

Green balls to be added $= 2$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

How many blue balls must be added to the bag you started with if the fraction of blue is now $\dfrac{1}{2}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$
\begin{aligned}

2b - b                                  &= 7 - 4 \\\\
b                                       &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Blue balls to be added $= 3$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many red balls must be removed from the bag you started with if the percentage of green is now $25\%$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many red balls must be removed from the bag you started with if the percentage of green is now $25\%$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of red balls to be removed = $r$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {7 - r} \times 100           &= 25 \\\\
\dfrac {1} {7 - r}                      &= \dfrac {25} {100} \\\\
\dfrac {1} {7 - r}                      &= \dfrac {25} {25 \times 4} \\\\
\dfrac {1} {7 - r}                      &= \dfrac {\cancel {25}} {\cancel {25} \times 4} \\\\
\dfrac {1} {7 - r}                      &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
7 - r                                  &= 4 \\\\
r                                       &= 7 - 4 \\\\
r                                       &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Red balls to be removed $= 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ravi has $32$ sweets. He eats $24$ of them. What fraction of the sweets has he eaten? Write your answer in its simplest form.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ravi has $32$ sweets. He eats $24$ of them. What fraction of the sweets has he eaten? Write your answer in its simplest form.
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                        &= \dfrac {8 \times 3} {8 \times 4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {8} \times 3} {\cancel {8} \times 4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3} {4}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $\dfrac {1} {3} - \dfrac {1} {6}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $\dfrac {1} {3} - \dfrac {1} {6}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {3} - \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {3 \times 2} - \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {6} - \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 - 1} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {6}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
